text:
eve: quick design review for breadcrumb + sidebar regrouping. i'm exploring a compact mode where groups auto-collapse but breadcrumbs still show full path. figma: https://figma.com/proto/compact-bc (frames). main constraints: stable deep links, no focus loss, accessible labels.
sam: question: if groups auto-collapse, should clicking a breadcrumb expand the relevant group in the rail? users expect that.
eve: yes — breadcrumb click should expand the nav to reveal the target and then focus the item. avoid full-page jump; use smooth scroll and announce to screen readers.
colin: routing note: prefer canonical paths for deep linking (/w/:ws/nav/teams/:id). UI-only state like collapsed/expanded should not be in canonical URL by default. use history.state for ephemeral state.
maya: copy nits: button label for the small kebab menu should be "Copy view (open sections)" rather than "Copy link with view". toast: "Link copied  includes open sections". keep wording concise.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist suggestion: 1) group headers tabindex=0; 2) aria-expanded present; 3) aria-controls id pattern navgrp-<id>-list; 4) live region announces "Navigation: teams expanded" on restore; 5) keyboard shortcut doc for focusing breadcrumb (e.g., Alt+N).
sam: engineer note: storing ephemeral open state in history.replaceState is good. on full reload fallback to sessionStorage. special-case: when someone explicitly copies view, encode minimal fragment (base64) rather than query params.
eve: decision proposal: (A) canonical deep links via path segments, (B) ephemeral UI in history.state + sessionStorage fallback, (C) explicit "Copy view (open sections)" encodes fragment, (D) breadcrumb clicks expand + focus target with smooth scroll + aria-live announcement, (E) labels: "Pin section" for persistent pin CTA, helper text "Keep section open".
colin: +1. i'll draft a tiny helper util for fragment encoding that strips potentially sensitive ids.
maya: i'll update copy strings and the toast variants for SRs. keep the banner subtle when loading a fragment: "This view opens additional sections" with dismiss.
eve: thanks everyone. i'll update the figma and add a short PR checklist here. sam: can you prototype the history.state restore and breadcrumb expand behaviour?
sam: on it 44d. will post a demo link when ready.
